personal.name: Parag Karkhanis
personal.title: VP Sales — Industrial & Manufacturing | Aerospace & Defence | Engineering & Digital Transformation Services

summary: Sales leader with 18+ years opening new accounts and growing revenue in engineering and digital transformation services. Spent most of my career as a hunter — landing first logos in markets where my employer had no presence, rebuilding lapsed relationships, and carrying the deal from a cold CxO conversation through workshops, RFPs, and contract. Strongest work in industrial and heavy machinery, aerospace, and manufacturing, selling ER&D, IIoT and Digital Twin, Industry 4.0, and cloud-enabled engineering. Built a region from zero in the Middle East; done the same kind of zero-to-one work twice since as an advisor to early-stage ventures.

Brought five clients onto the panel and developed a $2.5M pipeline within the first few months of engagement.
